title: Two Twisted Crowns
author: Rachel Gillig
summary: The concluding book of the Shepherd King duology. After the events of the first novel, the heroine and her allies face new truths about their kingdom as the stakes rise.
readIf: you want a conclusion to a dark romantasy duology.
skipIf: you have not read One Dark Window, since this book gives away its plot.

pairings.reason: The first book, which you need to read first.
Another dark court-intrigue fantasy with a sharp and ambitious heroine.
A fairy-tale fantasy with dark edges and well-built women characters.
